We design and build to WCAG standards throughout and provide testing documentation, so conformance is evidenced rather than assumed.

How We Deliver

Web Design Lane works remotely-first with Washington DC clients, which means faster turnarounds and no travel costs padding the invoice.

Discovery

A call to understand your business, your market and what the site actually needs to achieve.

Strategy & Planning

A written plan with scope, timeline, deliverables and the measures we will judge the result against.

Design & Build

Launch & Support

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work with associations and nonprofits?

Yes, frequently. Member portals, event registration, resource libraries and donation flows are all familiar ground.

Can you meet accessibility requirements?

Yes. We build to WCAG standards and provide testing documentation to evidence conformance.

Can you handle membership management?

Yes, including member areas, renewals, directories and integration with the association systems you already run.

How long does a project take?

Typically eight to twelve weeks, as review cycles in this sector tend to involve more stakeholders.
